content.title: Wight of Shadows
content.body:
A note I found, written by someone else in the past:

"This is the first day I've managed to find time to write ever since evil was released upon the land.
Just before, I was a scholar dedicated to the preservation of knowledge.
Then, the nether destroyed everything I stood for... except for my memory.

For some reason, although I have transformed into this hideous shape, as my fellow people have, I am... different.

The evil energies remain dormant in me, turning me dark as a shadow, and they have preserved my memory.

For those that may read this one day, remember me... remember me as Wight of Shadows."
